name: Camelot AMMv3 (Algebra) Factory

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: owner() is a real 2-of-3 Safe with no TimelockController anywhere in front of it - the thinnest authority setup in this batch.
narrative.detail: Only 3 total signers, no delay at all. Scored as-is rather than smoothed: a genuinely thinner authority setup than GMX, Radiant, the Security Council Safe or Aave on the same chain, not a scoring artifact.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)

curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x1a3c9b1d2f0529d97f2afc5136cc23e58f1fd35b","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x1ea1eec9"]}'
# getThreshold() on the holder (a Safe)
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<holder>","data":"0xe75235b8"},"latest"]}'
# getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<holder>","data":"0xa0e67e2b"},"latest"]}'

curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["<holder>","0x4a204f620c8c5ccdca3fd54d003badd85ba500436a431f0cbda4f558c93c34c8","latest"]}'
